semiconductor_relevance: High — Henkel Loctite specializes in providing advanced materials for semiconductor packaging, which are critical for the performance and reliability of microelectronics.
summary: Henkel Loctite (China) Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of qualified materials for semiconductor packaging, offering solutions that include die attach adhesives, underfills, and encapsulants. The company leverages its global resources to deliver innovative and cost-effective material technologies to top microelectronics companies.
capabilities: Die attach adhesives for wirebond packaging

regional_presence.China: Henkel has a significant presence in China, focusing on providing semiconductor packaging materials to local and global customers.
